verses.text: <pb/><e>Abù Ọma nke diri Onye-isi Abù; Abù Ọma nke umu Kora; n'elu Alamoth. Abù.</e> <pb/><t>Chineke buru ayi ebe-nb͕abà na ike,</t> <t>O mewo ka achọta Ya n'iye aka nke-uku na nkpab͕u nile.</t>
<t>N'ihi nka ayi agaghi-atu egwu mb͕e uwa nāb͕anwe,</t> <t>Ma-ọbu mb͕e anēwezuga ugwu nile n'ọnọdu-ha ga n'etiti oké osimiri;</t>
Mb͕e miri-ya nāb͕a aghara nāsu kwa ufufu, Mb͕e ugwu nile nēme nkpatu site na nbili-elu ya. Selah
<t>Otù osimiri di, miri-iyi-ya nile nēme ka obodo Chineke ṅuria ọṅu,</t> <t>Bú ebe nsọ nke ebe-obibi nile nke Onye kachasi ihe nile elu.</t>
<t>Chineke nọ n'etiti ya; agaghi-ewezuga ya n'ọnọdu-ya:</t> <t>Chineke gēyere ya aka mb͕e chi bọrọ.</t>
<t>Mba nile ozo b͕ara aghara, ewezugara ala-eze nọnọdu-ha:</t> <t>O mere ka olu-Ya da, uwa nabaze.</t>
Jehova nke usu nile nke ndi-agha nọyere ayi; Chineke nke Jekob buru ayi ulo-elu. Selah
<t>Jenu, hu ọlu nile nke Jehova,</t> <t>Onye doworo ihe-iju-anya di iche iche n'uwa,</t>
<t>Nēme ka agha nile kwusi rue nsọtu uwa;</t> <t>Ọ nāb͕aji uta, b͕upia kwa ube;</t> <t>Ọ nēsure ub͕ọ-ala nile n'oku.</t>
<t>Ranu aka, mara kwa na Mu onwem bu Chineke:</t> <t>Agēbulim n'etiti mba nile, agēbulim n'uwa.</t>
Jehova nke usu nile nke ndi-agha nọyere ayi; Chineke nke Jekob buru ayi ulo-elu. Selah
